title: Part One: The Phrase and Its Meanings

sections.brief: What Eretz Yisrael HaShlema means and how 'Greater Israel' mistranslates it; Netanyahu's Aug 2025 i24 'very much' as the hook (territories supplied by outlets, Arab/Islamic condemnation); Genesis 15:18 and Deut 11:24 vs Numbers 34/Ezekiel 47; nahar vs nahal, Nile vs Wadi el-Arish; a verse is not a programme (Pipes 1994, Herzl note pointer, myths pointer); Olmert 2008; the volume's frame: named actors never a people, fact/pattern/argument, 'record worse than the rumour' as hypothesis. Figure: compare

Three versions as this library's organising device, each tied to named carriers: maximal (minority Religious Zionist groups 1925, Hardal revival, Herzl note; never policy); Revisionist both banks (Jabotinsky 1929 song, Betar, Irgun; Labor partition acceptance 1947; Likud 1977 'western Eretz Israel'); post-1967 (Movement for Greater Israel July 1967 with Labor founders, 0.6% in 1969, into Likud; Likud 1977; 2022 guidelines); the currents that said no (ITO 1905-25, Allon Plan, withdrawals 1982/2000/2005, Olmert 2008). Figure: compare
